{{Current events header|2015|08|10}}

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*Two women attack the [[List of diplomatic missions of the United States#Asia|US consulate]] in [[Istanbul]] with automatic rifles. No fatalities are reported, and one of the attackers, wounded during the exchange of fire, is captured. The [[Revolutionary People's Liberation Party–Front|Revolutionary People’s Liberation Army-Front (DHKP-C)]] claim responsibility.  [https://www.the-newshub.com/international/terrorists-attack-us-consulate-in-istanbul (The News Hub)] [http://www.hurriyetdailynews.com/two-attackers-open-fire-on-us-consulate-in-istanbul.aspx?pageID=238&nID=86695&NewsCatID=509 (Hürriyet Daily News)]
*[[War in Afghanistan (2015–present)]]
**A [[Suicide bomber|suicide bomb]] blast kills at least 5 people at the entrance to the [[Hamid Karzai International Airport|Kabul International Airport]]. The [[Taliban]] have claimed responsibility. [http://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-33845326 (BBC)]
*Two people  are killed, and a third person seriously injured, during a stabbing at an [[Ikea]] store in [[Västerås, Sweden]]. [http://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/two-killed-in-swedish-ikea-attack/ar-BBlBx0z?ocid=spartanntp (BBC News, via MSN)] 
*[[Islamic State in Iraq and the Levant]]
**ISIL claims responsibility for a bombing in central [[Iraq]]i city of [[Baquba]] that has killed at least 30 people and injured 40 more. [http://edition.cnn.com/2015/08/10/middleeast/isis-iraq-violence/index.html?eref=edition (CNN)]
;Business and economy
*[[Google]] creates a new holding company called [[Alphabet Inc.]] containing [[Google|Google Inc.]] and [[Calico (company)|Calico]] containing [[Google Ventures]], [[Google Capital]], [[Google X]] and other subsidiaries. [http://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2015-08-10/google-to-adopt-new-holding-structure-under-name-alphabet- (Bloomberg)]
;Disasters and accidents
*The death toll from floods in [[Myanmar]] tops 100 with more than a million people affected. [http://www.skynews.com.au/news/world/asiapacific/2015/08/10/myanmar-flood-death-toll-tops-100.html (AAP via Sky News Australia)]
*[[2015 Gold King Mine waste water spill]] 300 million gallon spill of tailings and waste water starting August 5, 2015.
;Politics and elections
*[[Tony Smith (Victorian politician)|Tony Smith]] is elected as [[Speaker of the Australian House of Representatives]] replacing [[Bronwyn Bishop]] who resigned as a result of an expenses scandal. [http://www.smh.com.au/federal-politics/political-news/tony-smith-elected-new-speaker-following-bronwyn-bishop-resignation-20150809-giv9ln.html?utm_source=twitter&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=nc&eid=socialn:twi-13omn1677-edtrl-other:nnn-17/02/2014-edtrs_socialshare-all-nnn-nnn-vars-o&sa=D&usg=ALhdy28zsr6qiq (''Sydney Morning Herald'')]
;Science
*A [[night parrot]] has been captured for the first time in over a hundred years in Australia's outback. [http://www.theguardian.com/environment/2015/aug/10/night-parrot-capture-and-tagging-hailed-as-holy-grail-moment-for-bird-lovers (The Guardian)], [http://www.theaustralian.com.au/news/nation/looking-for-a-night-parrot-in-a-haystack-found-one/story-e6frg6nf-1227476639242 (The Australian)]
